market_name: Will 11 Fed rate cuts happen in 2026?

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check whether the market probability move persisted or was a thin-liquidity blip; cross-check 2Y/10Y Treasury yields and fed funds futures for corroboration.
time_plan.1h: Confirm rates futures (SOFR/SR3) are pricing more cuts; verify TLT tracking the yield move rather than idiosyncratic flow.
time_plan.2h: Look for a macro catalyst (data, Fed speak, risk event) that would justify the easing repricing; if none, downgrade conviction.
time_plan.6h: Reassess whether move is mean-reverting; check dollar and gold for confirmation of a coherent easing/risk-off narrative.
time_plan.12h: Evaluate net TLT move vs. thesis; note if the prediction-market signal led or lagged the bond move for the leakage study.

predictions.reasoning: A sharp rise in the implied probability of 11 rate cuts (275bps of easing) in 2026 signals expectations of aggressive Fed easing, likely tied to a recession or financial-stress scenario. That pushes the entire rate curve lower and bond prices higher; the front end rallies most but duration (TLT) benefits broadly from a flight-to-safety plus deep-easing repricing. Directionally the cleanest liquid proxy is long-Treasury duration.

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check DXY and major crosses (EUR, JPY) for direction; determine if move is risk-off (dollar-supportive) or pure rate-differential (dollar-negative).
time_plan.1h: Compare US vs. foreign rate expectations to confirm differential narrowing.
time_plan.2h: Assess whether haven flows are dominating; if VIX and gold spike hard, dollar thesis may invert.
time_plan.6h: Re-evaluate dollar direction against the risk backdrop; downgrade if signal incoherent.
time_plan.12h: Record net UUP move and whether the FX signal aligned with the bond signal.

predictions.reasoning: A jump in expected aggressive Fed cuts erodes US rate differentials, which typically weakens the dollar. However this is weaker and noisier because deep-easing scenarios often coincide with global risk-off that can paradoxically strengthen the dollar as a haven, muddying the sign.

evidence_used: Market question specifies 11 cuts = 275bps of easing in 2026, an extreme-tail easing scenario
Emergency/inter-meeting cuts count, tying the tail to crisis/recession scenarios
Standard macro linkage: aggressive Fed easing lowers yields (bonds up) and narrows rate differentials (dollar down)
uncertainty_notes: The 700bps tradable threshold is far above any plausible 12h move in these liquid proxies, so neither prediction is 'tradable' by that bar
11 cuts is a deep-tail outcome with tiny baseline probability; probability moves are dominated by thin-market noise
Equity direction is genuinely ambiguous (easing bullish vs. recession bearish), so no equity prediction offered
Category tag 'military_conflict' appears mislabeled; treated purely as a Fed-policy market

llm_justification.summary: This market asks whether the Fed delivers an extreme 275bps of easing (11 cuts) in 2026, effectively a proxy for a deep-recession/emergency-easing scenario. A sharp rise in its implied probability would forward-imply lower yields (long Treasuries up) and a modestly weaker dollar via narrower rate differentials. Both mappings are directional but low-conviction: the scenario is a deep tail dominated by thin-market noise, haven flows can invert the dollar sign, and expected 12h magnitudes fall well below the 700bps tradable threshold.
key_assumptions: A probability move reflects genuine information rather than illiquid-market noise
Aggressive expected easing transmits to lower Treasury yields within the window
No offsetting haven bid overwhelms the rate-differential dollar effect
failure_modes: Move is a thin-liquidity artifact in a deep-tail contract with no real information
Rate expectations already public/priced, so bonds don't move on the signal
Risk-off drives dollar UP (haven), reversing the FX prediction
Recession framing sends the move via equities/credit rather than the chosen proxies
Magnitudes far below the 700bps bar, making any signal untradable in practice
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
